title: He Bowed to God Alone
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Proud Haman wanted everyone
To bow when he walked by.
And everybody bowed down low
Except for Mordecai.

[Chorus]
We bow to God, and God alone,
We worship Him each day.
Be kind and gentle, but be brave,
And stand tall, come what may.

[Verse 2]
This made proud Haman very mad,
But Mordecai stood still.
He wasn't rude, just faithful, true,
To do the Lord's own will.

[Chorus]

[Verse 3]
Now close your eyes; tomorrow, too,
You'll do what's right and true.
The Lord is pleased when you stand tall,
And He stands close to you.

[Chorus]
mood: Standing music. A calm, upright, steady pulse holds under the voice like someone quietly standing still while everyone else bends low. The chorus is firm and full, brave without being loud. By the last verse the pulse slows and settles lower, the firmness softening into peace, and the song rests like a child lying down after standing tall all day.
